profile.headline: Software engineer at Disney Consumer Products
profile.summary:
A software engineer with 15+ years’ experience in building web applications using Java, Spring, Hibernate and other technologies looking for leadership managerial position. 

•	10+ years experience in Java, Spring 3.0, Spring boot
•	10+ years experience in Oracle, MYSQL, SQL Server and relational databases.
•	5+ years experience in templating languages such as JSP, freemarker, html.
•	3+ years experience using subversion, git and angular.
•	1+ years experience in front end development using JavaScript libraries such as JQuery(AJAX), JavaScript and Bootstrap.
•	1+ year experience in Grails
•	5+ years experience in ORM such as Hibernate
•	3+ years experience working with Tomcat server & XML
•	Knowledge of PHP and Unix



Specialties: HTML, Java, JSP, Spring3.0, Roo, Grails,  Ant, C++, MYSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Support Licensing teams by enhancing a global app written in Java, spring, angular. 
- API developments as well as bug fixes. 
- Use elastic search for all our search needs
- Support  bug fixing and enhancements. Written in java, spring and interfacing with documentum.
- Working with documentum's API and sql.
- Development of new CMT - content management tool written in java, spring, JDBC.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintain the multi-threaded application that sends out about 20 million emails a week
- Maintain and enhance the existing email application build on Java and spring framework
- Lead the weekly email cycles
- Perform A/B testing on the email campaigns that are send out
- Use Oracle as the backend database
- Maintain and enhance a mail admin web app build on java, spring, hibernate and a few google javascript libraries.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build and maintained our Content Management System using Java and Spring 3.0.
- Implemented server side coding for Hotel Transylvania facebook game. 
- Implemented code required to support www.fanta.com.
- Design, prototype, build and maintain several web application's using Java, Spring, Grails, Spring Roo and tiles.
- Good working knowledge of Alfresco CMS.
- Extensive experience with MYSQL and relational databases.
- Used hibernate as ORM for all the projects.
- Front-end development using Html and Javascript libraries such JQuery.
- Used templating languages such as jsp,  freemarker and tiles for creation of views
- Used Maven to build projects.
- Experienced in life cycle of software design process by designing, prototyping, building, implementing and testing an admin for the sonypictures iPhone app.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Programmed in C, C++, J2EE, Jboss, JSP, Java Beans, HTML, Struts
Worked with ISM database and IBM DB2 database
Build projects using Ant script
Worked in Unix/Linux environments
